From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly handoff & forecast checklist — update required before call

Team —

Quick reminder for today's forecast handoff: finance needs our finalized numbers by 1:00 PM PT so they can roll them into the weekly package. Please do the following before the 12:30 PM PT call: 

- Update each opportunity in HubSpot with: stage, expected close date, ARR, and commit/non-commit flag.
- Add a one-line risk note for any >$50k opportunities moving into Commit.
- Upload any price/term exceptions to the deal record and tag me.

I attached the forecast template in case you want to do an offline snapshot (optional). If you prefer, update HubSpot directly — either way I need the final export by 12:55 PM so I can validate totals.

Call details (12:30 PM PT): quick roll, highlight deltas >10% from last week, and confirm consolidated commit. Agenda in the invite: 1) Roll call and top 10, 2) Outlier flags, 3) Final sign-off + submission.

[Attachment: forecast_template_Q2.xlsx (xlsx)]

Link to sheet: https://drive.google.com/open?id=forecast_q2_template

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the updates — appreciate the quick turn. For today's 12:30 PM PT call here's a compact agenda so we stay under 30 minutes: 

1) Roll call + confirm HubSpot export is complete (5 min)
2) Top 5 deals (arithmetic review) — call out deltas >10% vs last week (10 min)
3) Open risks that will push close (legal/retention/SLA) — assign owners (10 min)
4) Final sign-off and who will submit to finance (5 min)

Dial-in / meeting link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123
Please have your HubSpot export ready (CSV or template). I will validate totals and post the consolidated snapshot to the finance channel after the call.

If ACME's SLA ask requires an exception, we'll pull legal into the thread and mark the deal as "Pending Legal" rather than Commit for the finance submission.

Thanks —
